hypotheses.H_semantics: A single-stage pre-edit behavioral counterexample check rescues at least one previously unseen issue without regression vs V2.
hypotheses.H_cost: Pre-edit verification consumes limited calls/time but does not correct the patch, producing no rescue or regressions.

major_variable: one appended, frozen behavioral-counterexample policy; SAME model, tool set, sample, time/calls/turns, evaluation environment

selection.method: exclude all previous manifest blocked IDs and compute its 3 old pilot picks from salted public IDs; hash-rank remaining per repository, freeze before reading task bodies or treatment results

experiment.primary: paired actual native grader resolved; unique rescues minus regressions
experiment.early_gate: at least 1 unique grader rescue, zero regressions, no invalid evaluator failures
experiment.stop: no net unique rescues or any regression -> retire exact policy; no prompt editing on same issues
experiment.promotion: Never declare improvement from n=3; if pilot shows rescue, require >=30 truly fresh paired gold-pass/noop-fail issues and confidence interval before official submission

data_safety: Private Kaggle competition-mounted task data; GitHub records only aggregate safe grader metrics, no raw issue text, reference patches or traces.
